# API reference

> Web Search, Contents, and Research APIs that give your AI app real-time web intelligence. Start with free credits.


## API Docs

- Web Search [Search](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/search/v1-search.md)
- Contents [Contents](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/contents.md)
- Answer [Answer](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/answer/v1-answer.md)
- Research [Research](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/research/v1-research.md)
- Research > Background Requests [Research Task Status](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/research/v1-research-task.md)
- Research > Background Requests [Research Task Stream](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/research/v1-research-task-stream.md)
- Finance Research [Finance Research](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/finance-research/v1-finance_research.md)
- Billing [Account Balance](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/billing/get-account-balance.md)
- Images [Images](https://you.com/docs/api-reference/images/images.md)
